title: Frequently Asked Questions
summary: Clear answers to common questions, so you know exactly what to expect before starting your consulting journey.

items.question: Who is this consulting for?
items.answer: This consulting is designed for professionals, founders, and individuals who feel stuck, overwhelmed, or uncertain about their next steps and want clear guidance to make better decisions and move forward with confidence.

items.question: How do the consulting sessions work?
items.answer: Sessions are conducted one-on-one in a structured format, either online or scheduled remotely. Each session focuses on understanding your challenges, identifying opportunities, and creating practical, actionable steps tailored to your situation.

items.question: Is this consulting short-term or long-term?
items.answer: Both short-term and long-term options are available. Some clients need clarity in just a few sessions, while others prefer ongoing support to work through complex goals, transitions, or long-term personal and professional growth.

items.question: What kind of results can I expect from this consulting?
items.answer: You can expect improved clarity, stronger decision-making, and a clear action plan. While results vary, clients often report increased confidence, better focus, and measurable progress toward their personal, career, or business goals.

items.question: Do you offer personalized guidance or general advice?
items.answer: All guidance is fully personalized. There is no one-size-fits-all advice. Every session is based on your specific challenges, goals, and context, ensuring the strategies discussed are realistic, relevant, and practical for your situation.

items.question: How do I get started with a consultation?
items.answer: Getting started is simple. You can book an initial consultation call through the website, where we discuss your goals, challenges, and expectations to determine whether this consulting approach is the right fit for you.
